Task A: finish the board components (project solace-cli/board)
1. Make solace_board.register and solace_view.register return Result(Nil, lustre.Error), as migration.register does: drop the let assert and return lustre.register(...). Update their main() to let assert Ok(_) = register().
2. Run the gleam tests and the js_tests command, rebuild with the bundle command, and add the WORK.md entry for step 4.
3. Done when both functions return Result and all board tests pass.
title: Fix Register return result
